brand.subtitle: Clone Builder · Digital life project
settings.description: Language changes instantly. Only this preference is saved on this device.
settings.motionNote: System reduced-motion settings are also respected. Brain rotation stops; selection remains available.
settings.authNote: This public prototype contains no real persona data. Future private Memory APIs require server-side authentication and authorization.
home.headline: Build a digital persona, one conversation at a time.
home.description: Capture words, memories and voice. Keep original evidence, then explore a clone.
home.brainCaption: A map of a mind, waiting for evidence.
home.workflowTitle: A mind takes shape over time.
home.cloneNote: A conversation grounded in traceable sources and honest uncertainty.
home.builderNote: Start with free conversation, a short interview or a recording.
project.next: Next: reviewed fragments & authenticated Memory API
brain.title: Digital Brain
brain.instructions: Hover to pause and connect. Click a region or module to select.
brain.emptyNote: No records are connected for this region. A future authorized Memory Browser will appear here.
region.personalityNote: Patterns supported by evidence over time
region.valuesNote: What matters, and why it matters
clone.description: A conversation layer above an evidence-aware core.
clone.emptyNote: Try the fictional learning question, or ask about a life event without a record.
clone.placeholder: Ask the demo clone a question…
clone.replyKnown: In this fictional demo, I learn by making a small prototype, then reflecting on what did not work.
clone.replyMissing: No reliable memory found. I do not have evidence to answer that question about you.
clone.whyKnown: Matched an explicit synthetic opinion about learning. The highlighted path is a visual demo, not live retrieval.
clone.whyMissing: No supported demo topic matched. Missing evidence is preserved instead of inventing a memory.
clone.memoryQuote: I learn best by building a small prototype and reflecting on what did not work.
privacy.demo: Research prototype. Reflective demo replies; no real LLM, persona extraction or voice synthesis is connected.
privacy.input: Your answers stay in page memory and clear on refresh. Use fictional examples for presentations.
privacy.export: Exports contain your entered text. Store them privately; they are not written to the Master Archive.
privacy.counts: Real archive counts remain 0. Demo structure is not a verified persona.
builder.description: Every conversation adds a small piece of structure.
builder.startNote: Five reflective questions. Scripted AI follow-ups. Original answers preserved.
builder.placeholder: Use a fictional example for this demo…
builder.question: Guided question
builder.closeNote: Close this session to inspect a memory capsule.
builder.progressNote: An ongoing archive. Counts accumulate; there is no fixed completion target.
builder.summaryNote: Synthetic samples produce illustrative evidence only. Your own answers remain raw and unconfirmed.
fragment.title: Memory Fragment Generated
fragment.raw: Raw capture only · no automatic extraction
fragment.note: No archive import. Demo IDs are not production IDs.
fragment.exportNote: Demo capture. Original answers are preserved. All candidates require review.
metrics.zeroNote: No personal archive connected. All statistics are 0; demo sessions are not counted.
dashboard.description: A transparent view of an archive still taking shape.
dashboard.title: Evidence accumulates over time.
roadmap.web: Unified 3D brain, cumulative records & local imports · available
error.title: Unable to load the interface
error.generic: Something went wrong. Your session remains in this page; please try again.
question.0: Think of a small project you enjoyed. What made it meaningful to you?
question.1: Why did that matter? What did you choose to prioritize?
question.2: What trade-off did you make, and what would you change next time?
question.3: What evidence could make you reconsider that decision?
question.4: How has your perspective changed over time?
sample.0: I enjoyed building a fictional garden planner. Making something useful mattered to me.
sample.1: I prioritized learning through a small working prototype.
sample.2: I chose a simple design over extra features so I could test it sooner.
sample.3: Feedback from someone using it would help me reconsider.
sample.4: I now ask for feedback earlier. This is a fictional demonstration.
evidence.language1: A reason attached to a choice
brain.canvasLabel: Interactive 3D brain. Use the six modules, or arrow keys to select regions.
upload.title: Upload Memory Fragment
upload.description: Bring an exported fragment back into this workspace. Parsing and review come later.
upload.privacy: Local session only. Nothing is sent to a server or written to the archive. Refresh clears imported files.
upload.listEmpty: No fragments in this workspace session yet.
upload.success: Fragment imported into this session. See the Fragment List or Persona Progress.
upload.duplicate: This file is already in the session. It was not added twice.
upload.typeError: Choose a Markdown or JSON memory fragment.
upload.sizeError: The file exceeds the 2 MB limit.
upload.jsonError: This JSON file is invalid or is not an object. Nothing was imported from this file.
upload.limitError: This session accepts up to 20 fragments and 6 MB of imported text.
metrics.workspaceNote: These counts accumulate in the current local session. Imported files await review and do not become verified memories.
metrics.demoOnly: Fictional sample only · no inference from imports
capture.accumulateNote: Conversations, fragments, transcripts and voice samples — counts, not a completion score.
capture.demoNote: Local rule-based follow-ups, not a live LLM. Your words are saved as raw capture, without inferred facts.
capture.welcome: Start with something on your mind.
capture.welcomeNote: A memory, a decision, a preference. You can type or record, then review the transcript before sending.
capture.placeholder: What would you like to talk about?
capture.followWhy: What made that important to you? You can add the context in your own words.
capture.followExample: Can you describe a specific moment that illustrates this?
capture.followValues: When this value conflicts with another priority, how do you usually decide?
capture.followReasoning: What alternatives did you consider, and what helped you choose?
capture.saved: Conversation saved in this browser only.
capture.localRecords: Browser-local records · not extracted persona evidence
capture.storageError: Local storage failed. Nothing was uploaded. Check browser storage permissions or quota.
audio.consent_for_transcription: Allow this recording to be transcribed locally
audio.consent_for_persona_analysis: Allow future persona analysis of this recording
audio.consent_for_voice_clone: Allow this recording as a voice-clone reference sample
audio.consentNote: All permissions are separate. Voice-clone permission is off by default. No training runs here.
audio.asrUnavailable: Local ASR is not connected. Recording and editable manual transcripts work; automatic transcription requires the local service. No cloud fallback.
audio.transcriptionRequired: Please authorize local transcription before using the conversation microphone.
audio.voiceConsentRequired: Explicit voice-clone sample permission is required.
audio.unsupported: Microphone recording is unavailable in this browser. Use HTTPS or localhost and allow microphone access.
audio.denied: Microphone permission was denied. No recording was saved.
audio.cancelled: Recording was discarded when leaving capture. The microphone is off.
audio.limit: Recording stopped at the 10-minute safety limit. Record shorter segments.
audio.uploadTitle: Bring a recording into your archive
audio.uploadNote: WAV / MP3 / M4A / WebM · up to 25 MB and 10 minutes. Files remain in this browser.
audio.typeError: Choose a WAV, MP3, M4A or WebM file.
audio.sizeError: Audio must be nonempty and at most 25 MB.
audio.durationError: Audio must be at most 10 minutes.
audio.decodeError: This file cannot be decoded as audio by this browser.
audio.storageLimit: This prototype allows 100 MB of local audio. Delete or download older recordings first.
audio.saved: Audio saved locally with its permissions. Nothing was uploaded.
audio.asrError: Transcription failed or the detected language is unsupported. The audio remains local.
audio.localOnly: Only your loopback ASR service receives this audio. No translation is performed.
audio.authorizeSample: Add as a voice sample with permission
audio.transcriptSaved: Transcript saved and linked to the original audio.
audio.noSpeech: No speech recognized. Review the recording or enter a manual transcript.
voice.title: Voice Collection
voice.note: Read a short passage in your own voice. Save a reference sample only with explicit permission.
voice.prompt: I remember the things that matter to me. My experiences and choices shape how I see the world.
voice.recommended: Suggested reference: 10:00+ · quality depends on the future engine
voice.storage: Saved in this browser (IndexedDB). No training, synthesis or third-party upload. Download originals for backup; browser storage is not a vault.
voice.saved: Voice reference saved with explicit consent. No model was trained.
audio.cloneNotEnabled: Voice synthesis is not enabled in this prototype.
